notes.title: Welcome to Coin Hunter
notes.notes:
I'm delighted that you've found your way to Coin Hunter.
As of today, the game is in Early Access and will be in Early Access for a maximum of 6 months.

Until then, new functions will be added, improved and expanded on a regular basis.
In addition, new worlds, other coins, more upgrades, more
Achievements and much more.

If you notice a bug, please report it in the forum, this will help the game and other players.
Of course, ideas and suggestions are also welcome.

So, now have fun playing and I wish you all a nice weekend.
